messages:
frank-partnerships: Heads up: Partner 'CloudParcel' flagged apparent duplicated daily usage for a subset of customers. Looks like events span two different days depending on which timestamp field we use (event_ts vs reported_local_ts).
kevin-revops: saw that on the morning digest. Their SI uses device-local timestamps which drift into previous UTC day when devices in JST report late. Our aggregation currently keys by event_ts (UTC-converted) but some partners are posting reported_local_ts too and neither is consistently populated.
anya-data: quick sample (redacted):
```
{customer: 'cp-501', event_ts: '2026-03-22T00:05:00Z', reported_local_ts: '2026-03-22T09:05:00+09:00', units: 10}
{customer: 'cp-501', event_ts: null, reported_local_ts: '2026-03-21T23:55:00+09:00', units: 10}
```
frank-partnerships: so same measured usage but different UTC bucket -> double counted in day-rollups.
simon-marketplace: proposal: unify ingest policy: prefer event_ts if present and valid; else derive UTC from reported_local_ts and annotate ingest.source_time = 'reported_local'. Add idempotency_key = sha256(partner_id + device_id + local_ts + sku). Use this key for ledger de-duplication within a 48h sliding window.
kevin-revops: +1. Also we should publish a contract note that partners must supply either event_ts (UTC) or reported_local_ts plus timezone offset. If neither present, mark event as 'time_unk' and route to recon.
anya-data: aggregation note: when deduping on idempotency_key, prefer the record with event_ts populated. For daily rollups, use ledger_time = coalesce(event_ts, convert(reported_local_ts)).
frank-partnerships: UI impact: partners want near-real-time dashboards. If we dedupe across a 48h window, previews may change retroactively. Need to surface a changelog and a "retroactive adjustment" column.
simon-marketplace: we can add an adjustments table in the console and an API endpoint /v1/partner-adjustments that returns pre- and post-adjusted totals with reason codes (timestamp-drift, duplicate-id).
kevin-revops: operationally: ledger-bridge: add dedupe window config and idempotency_key storage. Aggregator: run a nightly reconcile job to collapse duplicates and emit adjustment events. Hold any >0 ambiguous duplicates for 24h before auto-apply to allow partner claim.
partnerbot: webhook: delivery 200 OK for cloudparcel-webhook; signature ok.
frank-partnerships: owners: simon -> spec for idempotency_key + api endpoint by Tue; anya -> aggregator dedupe logic + nightly reconcile by Thu; kevin -> ledger-bridge idempotency storage + hold flag by Fri; frank -> partner advisory + contract amendment note by Wed.
kevin-revops: metrics: percent of events missing event_ts, number of idempotent hits, adjustments applied, partner-claimed rows. Alert if missing event_ts > 1% for a partner.
frank-partnerships: thanks all. i'll loop in CloudParcel's engineer and their SI for a 30-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:
thread_text_snippet: CloudParcel duplicate day-rollups due to event_ts vs reported_local_ts drift; plan: idempotency_key, 48h dedupe window, ledger holds, API adjustments, partner contract note
